headline: I've been alone a decade. How much longer?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see him, but your hand found the one whose table is still open.
Every tool remains laid out and ready for use.
You said you have been alone a decade and asked how much longer. The open table is where my eye goes.
Nobody has come, and the decade has made the question about what remains.
The thing that keeps connection away leaves the table open. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what is holding the meeting…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs gave nothing away, yet you chose the card held at one point.
One rope holds one ankle. Everything else hangs free.
You asked for the remaining length of a long pause. This card brings me to the single rope.
Still, the relationship is absent, and the waiting already has a long count behind it.
Something appears right where the pause would become a meeting. I don't think it started with you.
Let me see what's sitting there…
c: You turned the Fool. The picture was hidden, but your hand went to the one travelling light.
The small bundle on his stick is all he is carrying.
You asked how much longer after a decade alone. The light bundle catches my attention.
But the road has not brought connection, and you are asking how much more of it there is.
Something stands between the open road and connection. I don't think it began with you.
Now let's look at what's there…
